title: Microforms
summary: Microforms receiving full cataloging get a full set of subject headings by normal procedures; no heading or subdivision indicates the micropublication format. Collections of records get subdivisions such as --Archives, --Miscellanea, --Records and correspondence, --Sources, and a person or body whose activities the documents record gets --Archives or --Library.
validation_rules: Do not assign any heading or subdivision to indicate that a work is in the form of a micropublication (there is no microform form subdivision). (H 1893 sec. 1)
For collections of records, assign an appropriate subdivision such as `--Archives`, `--Miscellanea`, `--Records and correspondence`, `--Sources`. (H 1893 sec. 2)

If the documents record the activities of a particular person or corporate body, assign the name with a subdivision such as `--Archives` or `--Library`; omit it if the person or body merely houses the documents. (H 1893 sec. 2)

sections.heading: 1. Subject headings.
sections.text: Assign a full set of subject headings in accordance with normal procedures. Do not assign any heading or subdivision to indicate that the original work is in the form of a micropublication.

sections.heading: 2. Form subdivisions.
sections.text:
If the publication is a collection of records, assign an appropriate subdivision to bring this out, such as --Archives, --Miscellanea, --Records and correspondence, --Sources, etc.

If the documents reproduced record the activities of a particular person or corporate body, assign the name of the person or body with a subdivision such as --Archives or --Library, as appropriate. Omit the heading, however, if the person or body named is merely housing the documents but had nothing to do with their preparation.

sections.heading: 3. Geographic area codes and fixed field data.
